editorial:
Imagine getting to call the shots for one of the biggest nights in wrestling. That is exactly what happens here, where you get to see the fans pick the referees and the match rules in real time. You have heavy hitters like Batista and The Undertaker clashing for the World Heavyweight Title, while Randy Orton and Shawn Michaels bring their best for the WWE Championship. The energy is wild because the wrestlers don't even know what they are walking into until the votes are in. It feels less like a scripted show and more like a giant party where the crowd is in control.

What really makes this work is the high-stakes action and the surprising results of the fan votes. The pacing is quick, and the matches are hard-hitting, though some of the side fights feel a bit rushed. If you love sports drama and big personalities, you will have a blast. endingExplained: The night ends with a huge clash between Randy Orton and Shawn Michaels. After a grueling battle, Orton manages to secure the win to keep his WWE Championship. Meanwhile, the world title scene stays chaotic as Batista survives his match with The Undertaker. The whole event wraps up by showing that the fans' choices changed the course of the rivalries, leaving the champions standing but with new enemies ready to take them down.
